# Rejoy Solar Power Pvt. Ltd. (Chhattisgarh, India)
> Leading CREDA Empaneled Solar EPC, PM Surya Ghar Channel Partner & Industrial Megawatt Solar Contractor.

## Organization Summary
- **Entity Name**: Rejoy Solar Power Private Limited
- **Headquarters**: Pragati Nagar, Near Samaira Inn, Risali, Bhilai, Chhattisgarh - 490006
- **Phone**: +91 91799 11119 / +91 97525 21000
- **Email**: info@rejoysolarpower.com
- **Website**: https://rejoysolarpower.in
- **CREDA Vendor Registration**: CREDA/EPC/2023/CG-0894
- **Government Empanelment**: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Approved Vendor
- **Primary Service Territory**: Chhattisgarh State (Bhilai, Durg, Raipur, Bilaspur, Korba, Rajnandgaon, Jagdalpur, Raigarh, Champa, Ambikapur)

## Primary Offerings & Subsidies
1. **Residential Rooftop Solar**:
   - 1 kW to 10 kW+ On-Grid Rooftop Systems with Bi-Directional Net Metering from CSPDCL (Chhattisgarh State Power Distribution Co. Ltd.)
   - PM Surya Ghar Direct Subsidy:
     - 1 kW System: ₹30,000 Direct Subsidy
     - 2 kW System: ₹60,000 Direct Subsidy
     - 3 kW to 10 kW System: Maximum ₹78,000 Direct Government Subsidy
   - Payback Period: 2.8 to 3.5 Years
   - Solar Panel Warranty: 25 Years Performance Guarantee (Tier-1 Bifacial Mono PERC)
   - Inverter Warranty: 10 Years Replacement Guarantee

2. **Commercial & Industrial Solar EPC**:
   - Turnkey 50 kW to 10 MW+ Solar Power Plants
   - 40% Accelerated Depreciation Tax Benefit for Companies
   - Sub-3 Year Financial Payback
   - Open Access, Captive & Group Captive Solar Farms

3. **Solar EPC & Energy Storage (BESS)**:
   - Off-grid & Hybrid Solar Systems with LiFePO4 Lithium Battery Backup
   - Turnkey Civil, Electrical & DISCOM Liaisoning Services
   - 24/7 Operations & Maintenance (O&M AMC)

## Regional Offices & Coverage
